editorial.marketOverview: The post-PPI rebound has reversed sharply. Reuters reported the Nasdaq down 1.42%, S&P 500 down 0.93%, SOX down approximately 5% and Nvidia down 3.3% at 10:16 EST. Semiconductor weakness far exceeds the broad market's loss. These are intraday observations, not a confirmed closing trend.
editorial.whatChanged: The preceding 10:34 assessment reported Nasdaq down 1.08% at 10:08 but lacked Friday SOX confirmation. The new approximately 5% SOX decline verifies a much sharper semiconductor-led deterioration. This materially worsens the three-session path even though the bearish directional label remains unchanged. No new curated Open Watch event was verified.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The market's actual reaction has outweighed modestly softer October producer inflation. Nvidia uncertainty and AI concentration pressure semiconductor leadership. Reuters' estimate of a roughly 7% probability of a 50-basis-point December hike is reported pricing, not an independently verified live CME quote. Previous Treasury and oil values are asynchronous.
editorial.threeDayPath: Friday November 13 has heightened downside risk if the semiconductor selloff persists into the close. Monday November 16 tests whether sector-led selling continues or mean-reverts. Tuesday November 17 may see elevated positioning volatility around AI and rate catalysts, but exact earnings dates require issuer verification. The bearish path is stronger, not certain.
editorial.bullCase: A sustained reversal needs QQQ and Nasdaq to recover, SOX to outperform on synchronized timestamps, breadth to broaden and yields/volatility to ease. Isolated resilient megacaps and the mild PPI miss provide potential support but not confirmation.
editorial.bearCase: A roughly 5% SOX drop versus a 1.42% Nasdaq loss suggests concentrated semiconductor de-risking. If sustained through the close, it raises the probability of continued weakness Monday and Tuesday. Earlier negative breadth supports concern but cannot be represented as synchronized with 10:16.
editorial.watchNext: Check synchronized QQQ, SOX, VXN/VIX, Nasdaq breadth and matched 10Y/2Y yields before the Friday close. Verify updated Open Watch, oil quote timestamps, live Fed pricing and issuer-confirmed earnings. Avoid assuming any forecast catalyst has already moved the market.
